prompt: Challenge C115-CH1: Our anti-cheat system flags about 900 accounts a day but our manual review team can only process 200 — legitimate players are getting banned

content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Research focuses on supervised anomaly detection and classification under severe class imbalance in high-dimensional tabular datasets, with applications including fraud detection and behavioral data analysis.","sources":[{"id":"R0305","field":"bio","quote":"Her research group focuses on supervised anomaly detection and classification under severe class imbalance in high-dimensional tabular datasets, with applications in fraud detection, network intrusion, predictive maintenance, and clinical event prediction."}]},{"text":"Cost-sensitive weighting and ensemble learning methods such as bagging and random forests effectively improve detection of minority-class anomalies in imbalanced data, achieving higher precision-recall performance than undersampling alone.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-03781","field":"abstract","quote":"Cost-sensitive bagging achieves AUPRC of 0.81 and G-mean of 0.79, outperforming standard bagging and balanced bagging"}]},{"text":"Threshold selection strategies must be dataset-specific and calibrated to minimize misclassification costs, with expected cost minimization using asymmetric penalties outperforming universal decision rules on industrial sensor data.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-03782","field":"abstract","quote":"expected cost minimisation with an asymmetric penalty of 10:1 yields the best F1 on five of six datasets, whereas Youden's J performs poorly at extreme imbalance"}]}],"fit":"strong","fitReason":"The researcher's core expertise in imbalanced classification, cost-sensitive learning, and threshold calibration [R0305, SYN-PUB-03781, SYN-PUB-03782] directly addresses the challenge's need to reduce false positives in anti-cheat detection while maintaining true-positive detection, and the work on behavioral data and model explainability aligns with the requirement for decision transparency."}
